user.title: Connect Norish
user.description: Enter your Norish server URL and API key. Optionally provide your Norish login credentials to enable automatic API key renewal when the key expires.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Norish
reconfigure.description: Update your Norish URL, API key, or login credentials for automatic renewal.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Norish
reauth_confirm.description: Your Norish API key has expired. Please enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Please check the URL.

init.title: Norish Options
init.description: Choose how often Norish polls for updates. Lower values mean more frequent updates but use more API requests.
